$comment: Card art style bible, read by `npm run art:prompts`. Change wording here, not in individual prompts, so every card keeps the same style. See docs/card-art-guide.md.

shared.style: Anime 2D key visual, clean cel-shaded illustration with crisp ink linework, bold readable silhouette, strong rim light, painterly soft background with shallow depth of field.
shared.framing: Square image. One clear subject, centred, filling the middle 60% of the frame, with empty margin on every side so it can be cropped to landscape or portrait. Subject seen whole, not cut off by the edges.
shared.avoid: No text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermarks. No card frame, border or UI. Not photoreal, not a 3D render, not Western realistic concept art. No extra characters unless named.

scavengers.label: Scavengers
scavengers.palette: Weathered bright orange and rust armour plates, charcoal and dark grey joints, pistons and wiring, electric cyan-blue energy slits and cores, brown leather and tattered reddish-brown cloth.
scavengers.backdrop: Warm amber desert scrapyard, dusty haze, soft out-of-focus junk piles, a few sparks.

clockwork.label: Clockwork Collective
clockwork.palette: Antique brass and gold filigree over deep teal, warm candlelight rim, stained-glass accents.
clockwork.backdrop: Candlelit brass cathedral interior, deep teal shadows, soft bokeh of clock faces and gears.

cyberpunk.label: Cyberpunk
cyberpunk.palette: Black carbon and charcoal frames with restrained electric cyan and azure neon, dragon motifs.
cyberpunk.backdrop: Rain-hazed night city, restrained cyan and azure neon bokeh, dark carbon tones.

neutral.label: Neutral
neutral.palette: Cross-faction: orange copper plates with purple electric gauntlets (Glint) or brass and teal (Father Time); keep the faction colours of whichever mech appears.
neutral.backdrop: Dusty robot fighting arena under floodlights, blurred stands, dust in the air.

glint.description: Glint: slim orange copper mech with rabbit-ear antennae, cyan visor and purple gauntlets crackling with electricity.

rust_ranger.description: Rust Ranger: weathered orange gunslinger mech with a cowboy hat, tattered duster and dual sci-fi revolvers.

father_time.description: Father Time: brass cathedral automaton with a chest clock, kite shield arm and teal stained-glass panes.

seiryu.description: Seiryu: sleek charcoal mech with a dragon crest, energy blade arm and cyan backpack fins.

baron.description: Baron von Boar: hulking boar-headed brawler mech in a ragged white coat.
